# E0433: `when` on something that isn't shared

`when` holds shared values, of type `Shared<T>`. Use an ordinary value directly.

- Rule: [`shared.when`](../../reference/14-tasks.md#shared.when)
- Reported at: the name.
- Tier: `advanced`, checked in the `types` phase

## Example

This program makes the mistake:

```stilt E0433:2
fn bumped(n: i64) -> i64 {
  when n { n + 1 }
}
```

This one is fixed:

```stilt
fn bumped(n: i64) -> i64 {
  n + 1
}
```

## What the compiler prints

`stilt check` on [`E0433_when_on_something_that_isn_t_shared.lt`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0433_when_on_something_that_isn_t_shared.lt):

```text
── `when` ON SOMETHING THAT ISN'T SHARED ── E0433_when_on_something_that_isn_t_shared.lt:2:8  [E0433]

`n` has type `i64`, so `when` can't hold it; only a `Shared<T>` can be held:

  2 │   when n { n + 1 }
    │        ^

`when` holds shared values, of type `Shared<T>`. Use an ordinary value directly.
```
